messages:
rachel: hey all, first week question. trying to provision a tiny test cluster in project redwood-eval-eu (europe-west4) but hitting two blockers: 1) billing shows 'No billing account linked' even though people-ops sent an invite, and 2) when I try to assume the onboarding AWS role to run integration tests I get 'Invalid principal in policy'. unsure which team to ping to attach billing and validate the AWS trust. any quick tips? :wave:

diego: welcome rachel! short checklist: for GCP - check the Billing page and accept invite (spam/promotions). if accepted and still unlinked, infra can attach billing on your behalf. for AWS - that "Invalid principal" usually means the role's trust policy references a principal that doesn't exist or the account number is wrong. paste the role ARN and we'll have a look.

rachel: thanks. accepted the billing invite earlier but project still shows unlinked. gcloud I ran:
```
gcloud beta billing projects describe redwood-eval-eu
```
returns: "billingAccountName: \"\""

for AWS I ran:
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::222333444555:role/Redwood-Onboard-Test --role-session-name rachel-test
```
and got: "An error occurred (AccessDenied) when calling the AssumeRole operation: Invalid principal in policy"

olivia: hi rachel — people-ops sent the billing invite to your work email on day 0. i'll resend now. sometimes when auto-forwarding is set the acceptance flow doesn't complete; if you accepted via a forwarded link that can cause the project not to be linked. will DM the billing-account-id you should link.

infra-setup-bot: received request: attach billing for project redwood-eval-eu. Creating ticket INF-8614. Action: verify invite acceptance and attach billing-account 0000-2222-3333 if needed. ETA 2-3 hours. Also note: org policy restricts who can link billing; infra will need manager approval if project was created by non-admin.

cloud-ops: on the AWS side, common gotchas: 1) role trust policy references an IAM user/role in the onboarding account that doesn't exist or uses wrong account id, 2) external-id mismatch, 3) role requires MFA/session tags. if you paste the role arn or the trust policy snippet we can validate. Diego, can you cross-check the onboarding-account mapping?

diego: sure. @rachel if you can paste the output of:
```
aws iam get-role --role-name Redwood-Onboard-Test --profile onboarding-account --query 'Role.AssumeRolePolicyDocument' --output text
```
we'll inspect for an invalid principal. if you can't access get-role (due to perms), share the role arn and cloud-ops can fetch it.

rachel: i don't have permission to run get-role in the onboarding account. pasted role arn into DM to cloud-ops. also olivia i accepted the resend and confirmation showed success. thanks.

infra-setup-bot: update INF-8614: billing attach pending manager approval (auto-notified). if approval isn't granted in 2 hours, escalate to @olivia. For AWS role: cloud-ops will check trust policy and report.

cloud-ops: checked trust policy (internal note): role trust referenced `arn:aws:iam::222333444555:user/onboard-bot` which was deprovisioned. created PR to update trust to onboarding-account root/role. we'll rotate the trust policy and notify when done. expected patch to role within 1 hour.

rachel: awesome — thanks everyone. i'll try again after infra + cloud-ops confirm. one follow-up: do we need any special KMS key grants for test infra in europe-west4? i'm planning to encrypt local test volumes.

diego: good question. by default project-level CMEK is optional. if you want to use a customer-managed key, request `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` for the compute service account and add the service account to the key's IAM policy. infra can help add that once billing is attached.

rachel: perfect, noted. i'll wait for INF-8614 and cloud-ops update, and post here when I re-run the full flow. thanks again! :smile:
